1.consolidated_definition: Inauguración, estreno. Apertura de una empresa, generalmente acompañada de una fiesta, o inicio oficial de un espectáculo. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. El gran opening de la mejor tienda de cigarros “Amadiz Cigras”. Encuentro amistoso entre empresarios dominicanos y del area tri-estatal se reunen en el gran opening de la tienda de cigarros “Amadiz cigars”, la cual abrio sus puerta al publico, ofreciendo a sus clientes un servicio de primera (Sanahoria.com, consultado 08-06-09)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Inauguration, premiere. Opening of a business, typically accompanied by a celebration, or official commencement of an entertainment event. Anglicism, often used.

Grand opening of the best cigar store "Amadiz Cigras". Friendly meeting between Dominican entrepreneurs and those from the tri-state area gathered at the grand opening of the cigar store "Amadiz cigars", which opened its doors to the public, offering its clients a first-class service (Sanahoria.com, consulted 08-06-09)

Opening ceremony, inaugural event. Launch or debut of a business, often marked by festivities or an official start of a performance.

Grand opening of Amadiz Cigras, the top cigar store. A cordial gathering between Dominican businessmen and those from the tri-state area took place at the grand opening of Amadiz cigars, which welcomed the public with a first-rate service (Sanahoria.com, consulted 08-06-09)
